伽倻琴與玄琴提供撥弦的顆粒感；洋琴負責和聲與音準: The gayageum and geomungo give the granular sound of plucked strings; the yanggeum handles harmony and intonation
低音問題在韓國有一個很清楚的名字：奚琴與牙箏都補不到真正的低音。奚琴是高音樂器，: The bass problem has a clear name in Korea: neither the haegeum nor the ajaeng reaches a real bass. The haegeum is a high instrument, the ajaeng is low but weak in resonance, and no traditional instrument fills the gap between them. The usual practice is to let the improved daehaegeum or the bass ajaeng take the middle-low register and borrow cello and double bass for the very bottom; some orchestras use an electric bass or a synthesiser. The result is the same as in the Chinese orchestra and the Russian folk orchestra: the bass sounds foreign, and the orchestra's top and bottom come from two acoustic worlds.
兩者的基音、音量、節奏感都不同。合編需要移調、增刪編制與擴音，這些處理會改變音樂: The two differ in fundamental pitch, volume and sense of rhythm. Combining them needs transposition, sections added or cut, and amplification, and those treatments change the character of the music — putting two groups on one stage does not make them line up by itself.
協調上，指揮負責速度與平衡，但杖鼓仍然是時間的核心。正樂的長短、民俗的循環，都靠: In coordination the conductor is responsible for tempo and balance, but the janggu is still the core of the time. The cycles of jeongak and the loops of folk music are both marked by the janggu's patterns; the conductor decides how the whole thing stretches and shrinks, and the janggu decides where the players land. This double sense of time is where the gugak orchestra differs most from a symphony orchestra.
和四物農樂相比，差別在編制是否可變與時間由誰給。四物놀이 固定四件打擊樂器，沒有: Compared with samul nori, the difference is whether the line-up is variable and who gives the time. Samul nori fixes four percussion instruments, has no melodic part, is led by the small gong and works in units of rhythm patterns (jangdan); its players remember patterns, not scores. A gugak orchestra adds or cuts players according to the piece, keeps the janggu as one part among many, and writes the music in a full score.
國樂管弦樂團演奏的是古代傳下來的音樂。: A gugak orchestra plays music handed down from ancient times.
國樂管弦樂團（국악관현악단，gugak gwanhyeonakdan）是把韓國傳: The gugak orchestra (국악관현악단, gugak gwanhyeonakdan) is a large ensemble that arranges Korean traditional instruments the way a symphony orchestra is arranged and fills in range and volume with a set of improved instruments. It holds together two traditions that had little to do with each other: jeongak, the music of the court and the scholar-officials, and the folk music of the common people. The National Gugak Center and the gugak orchestras of the cities and provinces and of the broadcasting companies are the main homes of this line-up.
國立國樂院的定期演奏會、各市道國樂團的音樂會、廣播系統的國樂團錄音，是這個編制最: The National Gugak Center's regular concerts, the concerts of city and provincial gugak orchestras and the recordings of the broadcasters' gugak orchestras are this line-up's most stable stages; there are also school tours, festivals and recordings for film, TV and games. Crossover shows in recent years have taken it into pop venues as well.
大型合奏靠指揮；正樂與民俗原本都沒有指揮: Large ensembles rely on a conductor; jeongak and folk music originally had none
大笒是主要的歌唱性旋律；篳篥是雙簧管，音色尖亮；太平簫用於民俗段落與高潮: The daegeum carries the main lyrical melody; the piri is a double-reed oboe with a sharp, bright tone; the taepyeongso is used for folk sections and climaxes
大部分曲目是新作與改編，改良樂器更是二十世紀的設計。正樂與民俗的舊曲目進入樂團時: Most of the repertoire is new work and arrangement, and the improved instruments are twentieth-century designs besides. When old jeongak and folk pieces enter the orchestra they are transposed, thickened and rescored.
奚琴、改良奚琴、牙箏、改良牙箏: Haegeum, improved haegeum, ajaeng, improved ajaeng
奚琴是拉弦的旋律主力；牙箏用弓拉，音色低沉: The haegeum is the main bowed melody instrument; the ajaeng is bowed too, with a low, dark tone
收穫是規模：協奏曲、交響改編、影視與遊戲配樂、與板索里或流行歌手合作的大型製作，: What is gained is scale: concertos, symphonic arrangements, film, TV and game scores, and large productions with pansori singers or pop singers all need this line-up. What is lost is the microtones and lingering resonance of jeongak, the improvisation and regional variation of folk music, and the way pansori sings in close conversation with a drummer.
改良大奚琴、低音牙箏，或大提琴、低音提琴: Improved daehaegeum, bass ajaeng, or cello and double bass
改良樂器就是傳統樂器，只是做得比較好。: Improved instruments are traditional instruments, only better made.
改良樂器是為了音域、音量與平均律而重新設計的版本。奚琴、牙箏、伽倻琴的弦數、琴體: Improved instruments are redesigned versions, made for range, volume and equal temperament. The string counts, bodies and playing methods of the haegeum, ajaeng and gayageum all changed, and the timbre and the way microtones are controlled changed with them.
改良樂器是這個編制最明顯的工程。奚琴原本只有兩條弦、音箱小、音域高，改良奚琴加大: Improved instruments are the most visible engineering in this line-up. The haegeum originally had two strings, a small soundbox and a high range; the improved haegeum enlarges the box, adds strings and reaches downward, and there is a larger bass haegeum besides. The sound is thicker, but the traditional haegeum's microtones — the shaking, turning and retreating inflections — are harder to produce uniformly inside a section. The ajaeng was a seven-string bowed zither, low but weak; the improved ajaeng adds strings and enlarges the body, and a bass ajaeng below it supplies the roots, though it is still not a true contrabass. The gayageum went from twelve strings to a 25-string chromatic version with a wider range that can be played with both hands, at the cost of diluting the 12-string gayageum's stopping technique and its microtones. The piri and daegeum gained keys and became the improved piri and improved daegeum; the sheng was brought in for sustained harmony; and the yanggeum, because it can produce steady semitones, became the bridge between the orchestra and equal temperament.
教育與傳承由大學國樂科、國立國樂院的傳習制度與學校國樂教育支撐；業餘層面則有社區: Teaching and transmission are supported by university gugak departments, the National Gugak Center's training system and gugak education in schools; at amateur level there are community gugak orchestras and what is called living gugak. Professional orchestras are few, and amateur and school groups are the main channel through which the line-up has spread.
曲目以新作與改編為主：作曲家為國樂管弦樂團寫的創作樂曲、為奚琴、伽倻琴、大笒、牙: The repertoire is mainly new work and arrangement: pieces written for gugak orchestra, concertos for haegeum, gayageum, daegeum and ajaeng, orchestral arrangements of jeongak masterpieces (Sujecheon, Gwimyeon-gok and Yeongsanhoesang among them), arrangements of folk songs and nongak, collaborations between pansori and orchestra, and arrangements of symphonies and pop songs. Jeongak pieces are usually slowed and thickened when arranged, while folk pieces are tidied into concert form with an introduction, sections and an ending.
最容易和中國國樂團混在一起。兩者都是二十世紀的產物，都把傳統樂器拉成高音到低音的: This is most easily confused with the Chinese orchestra. Both are twentieth-century products, both pull traditional instruments into families running from high to low, and both have to borrow cello and double bass for the bass. The difference is who owns the time: in the Chinese orchestra the paigu and tanggu only mark sections and the conductor unifies the tempo; in the Korean orchestra, even with a conductor, the janggu remains the core of the cycles and their landing points, and the conductor governs the overall stretch. The source material is not symmetrical either: the Chinese orchestra deals with regional genres such as Jiangnan sizhu and Guangdong music, while the Korean orchestra has to fit two traditions of very different volume — jeongak and folk music — into one line-up.
杖鼓、鼓、鑼、小鑼、編鐘、編磬: Janggu, buk, jing, kkwaenggwari, pyeonjong, pyeongyeong
杖鼓維持長短循環；鑼鼓負責民俗的動態；編鐘編磬屬於正樂: The janggu keeps the jangdan cycles; the gongs and drums carry the folk dynamics; the bronze bells and stone chimes belong to jeongak
正樂與民俗的差別，不只是曲目差別，而是兩套音響美學。正樂慢、靜、以音為單位，樂器: The difference between jeongak and folk music is not only a difference of repertoire but two acoustic aesthetics. Jeongak is slow and still, measured in single notes, letting the instruments' resonance spread out naturally, with the janggu's cycles only a framework; folk music is fast and loud, measured in loops, with gongs and drums driving the dynamics and melodic instruments free to add ornaments. Put the two in one orchestra and the first problem is volume: a single taepyeongso can cover a whole section of haegeum, and one gong can make a jeongak geomungo disappear entirely. The orchestra's response is practical — when arranging jeongak it doubles the strings and cuts the folk percussion; when arranging folk music it keeps the framework of gongs and drums but gives the melody to the whole orchestra.
正樂與民俗都是韓國傳統音樂，放進同一個樂團很自然。: Jeongak and folk music are both Korean traditional music, so putting them in one orchestra is natural.
聽低音。是大提琴與低音提琴，還是改良大奚琴與低音牙箏；這一層決定樂團聽起來偏「國: Listen to the bass. Is it cello and double bass, or improved daehaegeum and bass ajaeng? This layer decides whether the orchestra sounds more gugak or more symphony.
聽奚琴的微分音。注意搖聲、轉聲、退聲有沒有做出來；在合奏裡，這些音高滑動常常被平: Listen for the haegeum's microtones. Notice whether the shaking, turning and retreating inflections come through; in an ensemble these pitch slides are often worn away by equal temperament and even bowing.
聽改編。正樂的餘音在管弦樂團裡還剩多少，是判斷改編成功與否最直接的線索。: Listen to the arrangements. How much of jeongak's resonance survives inside the orchestra is the most direct clue to whether an arrangement has worked.
聽杖鼓。即使有指揮，杖鼓仍然是長短與落點的核心；注意它如何標記段落，而不只是打拍: Listen to the janggu. Even with a conductor it remains the core of the cycles and their landing points; notice how it marks the sections rather than merely keeping time.
聽正樂與民俗在同一場音樂會裡的差別。音量、音色、節奏感都不一樣，這個落差就是編制: Listen for the difference between jeongak and folk music within one concert. Volume, timbre and sense of rhythm all differ, and that gap is the tension built into the line-up.
與雅樂（gagaku）相比，差別在傳承是否中斷。雅樂是宮廷與神社寺院延續下來的固: Compared with gagaku, the difference is whether transmission was broken. Gagaku is a fixed repertoire and line-up carried on by the court and by shrines and temples; its instruments are not made into families, there is no conductor, the tempo is locked by the taiko and kakko drums, and players aim to get the existing details right. The gugak orchestra is a redesigned organisation: instruments improved, scores read, control by a conductor, and a repertoire mainly of new work and arrangement.
表中的分組是折衷的結果。正樂的樂器——玄琴、大笒、奚琴、牙箏、編鐘、編磬——音量: The grouping in the table is a compromise. The jeongak instruments — geomungo, daegeum, haegeum, ajaeng, bronze bells and stone chimes — are quiet and fine in timbre and care about resonance and duration; the folk instruments — taepyeongso, gong, buk — are loud and coarse and care about rhythm and improvisation; the janggu spans both, marking the cycles in jeongak and driving the loops in folk music. For the two groups to share one stage, numbers, arrangement and amplification have to make it possible.
補根音；這一層沒有一件真正屬於傳統的樂器: Supplies the roots; not one instrument in this layer is truly traditional
韓國傳統樂器原本沒有一個統一的「家族」概念。大笒（대금，daegeum）、奚琴（: Korean traditional instruments never had a single concept of a family. The daegeum (대금), haegeum (해금) and gayageum (가야금) each have their own range and playing method and are not interchangeable the way the violin family is. The orchestra's work is to sort them into a group that can play counterpoint against each other, and to build new sizes of instrument for every gap.
韓國國樂管弦樂團（Gugak Orchestra）— 以改良樂器補齊音域與音量、: Korean Court-Music Orchestra (Gugak Orchestra) — a Korean large ensemble that fills in range and volume with improved instruments while holding both jeongak and folk music. Ensembles and instrumentation by Next Door Sound Weavers.

音高是第二層問題。正樂與民俗的基音不同，同一首曲子移調之後，樂器的共鳴位置與演奏: Pitch is the second layer of the problem. Jeongak and folk music sit at different fundamentals, and once a piece is transposed the instruments' resonance and the feel under the fingers both change: move jeongak up and the geomungo's low resonance thins out; move folk music down and the taepyeongso loses its edge. The orchestra has to settle on one hwangjong pitch first, then transpose the two repertoires separately, and this process is not neutral technical handling — it changes the colour of the music directly.
